summary: Describes Quality for Service (Q4S), an application-level protocol based on HTTP and SDP for communicating end-to-end quality compliance. It negotiates and monitors latency, jitter, bandwidth and packet loss, and raises alerts when negotiated conditions are violated.

eli5.summary: Before a video call, two sides check the connection is good enough and keep an eye on it, shouting if it gets worse.

questions: what is the quality for service protocol
how to monitor latency and jitter between endpoints
